name: First Steps
description: Mark your first chapter as read.

name: Good Start
description: Read on 3 days in a row.

name: Faithful Week
description: Read on 7 days in a row.

name: Devoted
description: Read on 30 days in a row.

name: Steadfast
description: Read on 100 days in a row.

name: A Year in the Word
description: Read on 365 days in a row.

name: Morning Watch
description: Read before 7 am on 7 different days.

name: Evening Psalm
description: Read after 9 pm on 7 different days.

name: Plan Finisher
description: Complete a reading plan.

name: A Hundred Chapters
description: Read 100 chapters.

name: Explorer
description: Read a chapter in each of the 10 sections of the Bible (Law, History, Gospels…).

name: Book Finisher
description: Read every chapter of a book of the Bible.

name: Five Books
description: Finish 5 books of the Bible.

name: Wisdom Seeker
description: Read all 31 chapters of Proverbs.

name: Gospel Reader
description: Read all four Gospels (89 chapters).

name: Letters of Paul
description: Read Romans to Philemon (87 chapters).

name: Songs of Praise
description: Read all 150 Psalms.

name: The Law
description: Read Genesis to Deuteronomy (187 chapters).

name: New Testament
description: Read all 260 chapters of the New Testament.

name: Halfway There
description: Finish 33 books of the Bible.

name: Old Testament
description: Read all 929 chapters of the Old Testament.

name: Through the Bible
description: Read all 1,189 chapters of the Bible.

name: Treasured Word
description: Save your first favorite verse.

name: In the Margin
description: Write your first note about a verse (long-press a verse in the reader, then Add Note).

name: Scribe
description: Write 5 study notes.

name: Highlighter
description: Highlight 25 verses in the reader.

name: Treasure Chest
description: Save 25 favorite verses.

name: Faithful Scribe
description: Write 25 study notes.

name: The Christmas Story
description: Between December 20 and 26, read Luke 2 or Matthew 1–2 to the end in the reader.

name: He Is Risen
description: During Easter week (Palm Sunday to the Sunday after Easter), read a resurrection chapter (Matthew 28, Mark 16, Luke 24, John 20 or 1 Corinthians 15) to the end in the reader.
